claims.statement: AWS-003 (MEDIUM) on aws:811596193553/us-east-1 under account Level6: Cloud service discovery burst. 'Level6' made 132 read calls across 16 distinct services in 468s, 28 of them refused (21%). Breadth on this scale is consistent with account enumeration, and is also exactly what inventory and compliance tooling does. The rule counts how many services were read, not which, so it cannot say whether the target was the account's service inventory or its infrastructure.

AWS-004 (MEDIUM) on aws:811596193553/ap-northeast-1 under account Level6: Authorization-denial burst. 'Level6' was refused authorization 28 times in 444s, across 4 distinct resource types. Concentrated on so few kinds of object, this is equally the shape of an application missing one permission and retrying. A refusal says what the platform would not do; it does not say what the caller intended.
